reason: The plugin’s purpose is to help users discover and vet DSH plugins: it accepts plain-language queries, searches indexed plugin sources, cross-checks against known registries, runs a pre-install scan, and supports installing only after user approval. This is primarily a plugin search/browsing utility with network-based registry and repository access, so it is classified conservatively as a search-oriented external-services integration tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件是面向 DSH 的插件发现与检查工具，支持按自然语言检索候选插件，并在安装前给出扫描报告供用户确认。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin that lets users find candidate plugins with natural-language queries and view a pre-install scan report before adding them.

capabilities: Remote lookup of plugin candidates via GitHub topic/registry queries
Remote fetch and analysis of candidate plugin metadata/source for risk indicators
Triggering/participating in DSH profile plugin installation or removal flow

reasons.code: README explicitly states the plugin searches the live dsh-plugin topic with filtering, then cross-checks candidates against curated registries before reporting.
README describes a pre-install security scan that checks lifecycle scripts, external domains, subprocesses, credential-read patterns, and prompt-injection related risks.
Package manifest declares a DSH bundle and README documents install/remove commands that affect the active DSH profile plugin set.
